basis.note: The basis column names the published derivation. Its kind is confidence-pbox: the file is a p-box combining workflow p-boxes, so no single workflow identifier would be true of it.

quantileBasis.note: The medium-confidence files are p-boxes combining workflow p-boxes, named in each file's source attribute. A value is a bound on a quantile across the combined workflows, not a quantile of one distribution, and no workflow id is claimed. AR6 derives a likely range (17th-83rd) from medium confidence and states it cannot derive a very likely range (5th-95th).
quantileBasis.availableButNotExtracted: the file publishes 107 quantiles including 0.0 and 1.0; these are not a range and not a worst case

units.note: Values are written as published. scale_factor is applied; the host declares the unit on import and converts for comparison.

missingData.note: A fill value is written as an empty cell. Never 0, never "nan".

baselinePeriod.note: No file attribute carries the baseline period; it is stated from documentation and never inferred from the data.
